back.target: to go (in or on a vehicle), to travel, to ride; also to drive
back.example: We're going to Berlin by train tomorrow.

note: The hint is needed and works: "not on foot" rules out gehen, and the word's other card ("to drive") asks for the same word, so it doesn't compete; Spanish ir-go is plain "to go" with no vehicle meaning, so null is correct.
